title: EvalResultBatch
description: One publish of agent eval results. This is the contract an EXTERNAL harness targets, which is why it is frozen here rather than being an internal shape: the CLI validates against this file with ajv and the control plane validates against a hand-written mirror of it, and a test asserts the two agree. Nothing here may carry a filesystem path or secret-bearing evidence - a published result is browser-visible by design.

apiVersion.description: Frozen. An unknown version is refused loudly rather than guessed at - the house posture in place of a migration framework.

runId.description: The idempotency key. A re-publish of the same (componentId, runId) is a no-op, so a retried publish cannot duplicate a result.

componentId.description: The Nexus component this result belongs to. A token may only publish for components inside its scope.

status.description: The runner's own RunStatus vocabulary, verbatim (cli/src/eval.ts). `pass` is the only one that reads healthy; the two error states are harness failures, not agent behaviour, and stay distinguishable.

harness.description: What produced this result (`hg eval`, a local harness name). Recorded so a surprising result can be traced to its producer.

metadata.description: Bounded, flat, and string-valued: an unbounded map is an exfiltration path, not a feature.

artifacts.description: REFERENCES only, and https only. A filesystem path is structurally impossible here, which is the point.
